name: CWF Television Championship
epitaph: The fed's own served Title Histories page records exactly one former holder against every other title ("n/a"): Kula, 18 January 2002 to 25 January 2002. The fed's own served Current Champions page names Apocalypse as the reigning Television Champion — the belt's own last-attested state. Read together with the two served shows (Kula defeats Apocalypse at Friday Night Blitz, 18 January 2002; Apocalypse defeats Dr. Doom and Kula at "Babylon," 25 January 2002), this is the whole title's own recorded lineage in the held record: two reigns, both structured here.

name: CWF United States Championship
epitaph: The fed's own served Title Histories page records no former United States Champion; the fed's own served Current Champions page names Dr. Doom as the reigning titleholder — read together, the belt's own founding and only recorded reign in the held record, with no document surviving to say when or how he won it.

name: CWF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: The fed's own served Title Histories page records no former Hardcore Champion. Mike Maddness earns the #1 contendership at Friday Night Blitz (18 January 2002), beating Xtreme T through a trash can; by "Babylon" (25 January 2002) he is already champion, successfully defending against eXodus — the title changed hands, off-page and unrecorded, sometime in the week between the two shows. The belt's own founding and only recorded reign in the held record.

name: CWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Named among the fed's own five recognized championships on both the Title Histories and Current Champions pages, but no reign was ever recorded — the belt sits Vacant as of the held record's own last snapshot. The fed's own "Babylon" card billed owner Phoenix to address the promotion concerning it, but no document records what, if anything, he announced.

name: CWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Named among the fed's own five recognized championships on both the Title Histories and Current Champions pages, but no reign was ever recorded — the belt sits Vacant as of the held record's own last snapshot.
